games.name: PULSE
games.instruction: Tap when the ring enters the target band.
games.ghostPolicy: rival cumulative score arc; rival hit marker only after local input

games.name: SNAP
games.instruction: Tap the valid target. Ignore the decoys.
games.ghostPolicy: rival progress; reveal rival choice only after local round resolves

games.name: ORBIT
games.instruction: Lock the marker inside each target arc.
games.ghostPolicy: rival lock notch appears only after local tap

games.name: RECALL
games.instruction: Watch the sequence. Repeat it from memory.
games.ghostPolicy: progress only until local answer; never leak cells

games.name: SHIFT
games.instruction: Follow the current rule. Choose left or right.
games.ghostPolicy: progress only; rival direction after local answer

games.name: TRACE
games.instruction: Stay inside the spectral path and clear every gate.
